profiles.name: Music Department
profiles.title: Elaine Fletcher, Pianist
profiles.bio: The music department is responsible for music at morning service, midweek, the Lord’s Supper, Discipleship Training, and all evening and outside programs designated. The Music Department includes the Mass Choir, Women’s Choir, Youth Choir, and Male Chorus.

profiles.name: Women’s Ministry
profiles.title: Earlie Fugate, President
profiles.bio: Our focus is to be a ministry where women are encouraged and enriched by studying and applying God’s Word.

profiles.name: Usher Board
profiles.title: Richard Washington, President
profiles.bio: The ushers shall attend to the seating of the congregation and to such other duties as may be directed.

profiles.name: Culinary Department
profiles.title: Brenda Stokes, Department Head
profiles.bio: It shall be the duty of this committee to organize feeding functions of the church.

profiles.name: First Aid Care Committee
profiles.title: Tawanda Maxwell, President
profiles.bio: Render services needed to the congregation.

profiles.name: Discipleship Training
profiles.title: Minister Doralyn Warren & William Stanley Jones, Superintendents
profiles.bio: Shall be responsible for training and teaching the membership how to become more like Christ.

profiles.name: Transportation Committee
profiles.title: Jesse Shields, Department Head
profiles.bio: It shall be the responsibility of this committee to provide transportation for church services and activities. A schedule of drivers will be prepared, and drivers must possess a valid driver’s license.

profiles.name: Youth Department
profiles.title: Tonya Gill, Department Head
profiles.bio: To assist boys and girls, ages 5 and up, in the stages of transition to becoming healthy and strong Christian men and women.

profiles.name: Decorations
profiles.title: Janice Jones, Department Head
profiles.bio: It shall be the responsibility of this committee to decorate the sanctuary with seasonal decorations or decorations to present a particular theme. This committee is also responsible for decorations for special events.

profiles.name: Custodial
profiles.title: Uvette Kizer & Margaret Faulkner
profiles.bio: It shall be the responsibility of this committee to provide for the maintenance and upkeep of buildings.

profiles.name: Lawn Keeper
profiles.title: Derek Strong, Department Head
profiles.bio: It shall be the responsibility of this committee to provide for the maintenance and upkeep of buildings and grounds. This shall consist of exterior and interior.

profiles.name: Courtesy / Hospitality
profiles.title: Mary Dumas, Department Head
profiles.bio: It shall be the duty of this committee to welcome visitors to church services, membership to church services, and visiting churches.

profiles.name: Photographer
profiles.title: Elbert Speers
profiles.bio: It shall be the duty of the committee to gather and maintain any and all pictures that will contribute to the cumulative history of the church.

profiles.name: Video / Audio Ministry
profiles.title: Calvin Cole, Jr., Elbert Spears, Derek Strong
profiles.bio: One who controls the sound/volume. Also, one who records the services for those who desire a copy or cannot attend service in person.

ministries.introText: Learn more about the ministries and leaders who serve the Mt. Moriah Missionary Baptist Church family.
